suite_name: PRD-CASE paper suite v2 (post-pilot validity revision)
evidence_role: The v1 preconditioned-expansion results are transparent pilot/descriptive evidence. The matched A-CASE extension is frozen here before its first suite-wide execution; it is the only new confirmatory comparison in v2.

pilot_provenance.selection_rule: For each declared physical family and size, retain the largest preregistered M for which orthogonal residual and SVD-orthonormalized Krylov had matched effective rank on every interaction or geometry member. The rule uses only the producer invariant, never an energy or method ranking.

analysis_revision.reason: The v1 global M grid crossed exact effective-rank ceilings on nine of twelve physical instances. Those producer rejections are retained as negative pilot results; v2 narrows only invalid budgets and does not select systems or M values using energy accuracy.
analysis_revision.reuse_policy: v1 records may be described as pilot evidence but are not relabelled confirmatory. New matched A-CASE records are hashed to this resolved v2 manifest.
